fz-ts-footnote-row.owner: server (Rust typeset rows); client side checked by ui-51
fz-ts-footnote-row.why: after typing in a footnote's text the run's own satex/typeset rows (satexTypesetOrigins) hold the footnote twice: the new text (line 3) and the old `1A short note.` (line 8), also after the run lands; the client shows what it gets. Needs the server to drop the previous run's footnote insert. Timing dependent (1 of 3 runs)

sync-usetikzlibrary.owner: server (Rust rerun from a checkpoint); evidence by ui-51
sync-usetikzlibrary.why: the client is in sync (last didChange text == editor text, findings version == sent version), but the wasm run of the final text reads `\\use`/`\\useti` (the name as an earlier run met it mid-typing) followed by `tikzlibrary…` as text: a rerun resumes inside line 3 with the old token; native `satex lint` of the final text is clean

sync-stray-brace.why: the wasm server publishes an empty diagnostics list for the text's version (raw publishDiagnostics captured: `diagnostics: []`), also with the brace there from the start (no resume), while native `satex lint` of the same text reports C013 `Too many }'s` at 8:18: the client shows what it gets
